scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api "npm run dev --workspace webapp" "npm run dev --workspace server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace webapp && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.apk:build: cd mobile && eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.android:apk: cd mobile && eas build -p android --profile preview --clear-cache
scripts.ios:preview: cd mobile && eas build -p ios --profile preview --clear-cache
